title: Side Lamp
body:
"Whilst they may look like they belong in a pool, they definitely get the job done."

Description

Side Lamp is a one-time use schematic purchasable at Illumine Designs for $600.

When placed on the property, it allows you to fill the lamp with a material for the outside, but does not affect the color of the light inside.

This light is able to be toggled either on or off with no dimming option like the Neon Tube.

This item is not resizable and takes the dimensions 1.5 studs long and 2 studs tall.
